Questions before you come

Do I need yoga experience?
No. The pace is slow and every posture is offered with a gentler option. If you can breathe, you can join us.
Can we talk at all?
Note-passing is allowed for logistics only — finding a bathroom, a missing item, that kind of thing. Otherwise, we stay silent from 8:30 AM until the closing circle at 4:30 PM.
What should I bring?
Layers — the grove is cool in the morning and warmer by afternoon. A journal, if you keep one. Your own yoga mat if you have a favorite; we have a limited number to lend.
What if it rains?
We go rain or shine. Outdoor sessions move to a heated indoor studio on the property when needed.
What's your cancellation policy?
Full refund for cancellations made 14 or more days before December 2, 2026.
Is lunch included?
Yes — a vegetarian lunch is provided and eaten in silence, as part of both pricing tiers.
How many people attend?
We cap the retreat at 20 participants, to keep the silence intact.

Your facilitator

Mara Whitfield, E-RYT 500

Mara has led silent retreats since 2014, drawing on a decade of study in vinyasa and restorative yoga alongside a long personal meditation practice. She founded Still Grove to offer a single, unhurried day among the redwoods — no retreat center check-in, no crowded schedule, just space to be quiet.
